# TFR UK rework v2 - part core. Generated by SCRATCH/build2/core_work/gen_core.py.
# on_startup: refresh the ENG focus tree layout after the mod's own on_startup logic
#   (DynamicCountries.txt sets the noAsia / majors_only flags on day one).
# on_weekly_ENG: safety net for the caps of contract 3.1 - clamps and re-reads the ENG national spirits
#   even if some reward forgot to call ENG_refresh_modifiers after add_to_variable.
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = ENG }
				ENG = { country_event = { id = tfr_eng_core.1 days = 3 } }
			}
		}
	}
	on_weekly_ENG = {
		effect = {
			ENG_refresh_modifiers = yes
		}
	}
}
